intro: Tarzana, named for Edgar Rice Burroughs' Tarzan after the author's ranch here, runs along Ventura Boulevard west of Encino, with a strong mix of Israeli, Persian, Eastern European, Japanese and French restaurants.

gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)

places.w: A newer Persian cafe with a calm, sunny room, creative drinks and good breakfast toasts.
places.o: A cappuccino and the salmon toast.

places.w: An Israeli grill known for fresh hummus, hot bread and an endless spread of small salads.
places.o: Hummus topped with meat, plus the salads.

places.w: A white-tablecloth Eastern European restaurant with house-infused vodka flights.
places.o: Borscht, potato vareniki and the chicken Kyiv.

places.w: A busy neighborhood sushi bar with an all-you-can-eat option.
An upscale kosher Mediterranean tapas restaurant that turns into a party with a DJ later at night.
places.o: Bluefin crispy rice and the market salad.

places.w: A father-and-son French restaurant open for more than 50 years, with a cozy lodge-style dining room. Dinner Wednesday through Saturday.
places.o: Duck a l'orange and the creme brulee.
